name: @dsh-external/dsh-weather-sky
description: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面叠加一层实时天气与天空动画——白天显示太阳，夜晚显示带真实月相的月亮，并按天气呈现云、雨、雪、雾，以及周期性的闪电。Overlay a live weather & sky animation on the DeepSeek Harness UI: sun by day, moon with real phases by night, plus clouds, rain, snow, fog, and periodic lightning.
